hotels.title: Victoria Escape in Grampians National Park with Fine Dining Restaurant
hotels.description: Set in the town of Dunkeld at the foot of the Grampians National Park, the Royal Mail Hotel, Dunkeld brings together mountain views, thoughtful regional dining and a restful country stay. Settle into rooms and cottages surrounded by landscaped Australian gardens, sophisticated interiors and sweeping views of nearby Mount Sturgeon. When hunger strikes, savour degustation at its best at Wickens or casual dining at Parker St Project. Spend your days exploring walking trails, adventuring through the Grampians, sampling local produce and taking in wild beauty of western Victoria. Closer to home, taste wines in the cellar or visit Australia's largest working restaurant kitchen garden or book a private session in the spa and sauna.
